detailed_descriptions_html.en:
FROM BARN FIND TO SUPERBIKE

Every bike in your shop starts as a rusty wreck nobody wants. Your job is to buy it cheap, bring it back to life and sell it for a profit. Restore motorcycles part by part, ride them through a living city and grow a small garage into the best dealership in town.

  • Restore every part: clean, repair and tune the engine, exhaust and tires

  • Make it yours: fresh paint jobs and custom decals

  • Ride before you sell: test rides through city streets and highways

  • Close the deal: negotiate with sellers and buyers for the best price

  • Grow your business: expand your workshop, showroom and lifestyle

BUY CHEAP, FIX SMART, SELL HIGH

Scout the market for underpriced motorcycles and decide which ones are worth the risk. Strip them down, fix what's broken and tune every part until it runs like new. Then give it a fresh paint job and custom decals to make it stand out. The better the bike, the better the price, as long as you can close the deal.

RIDE THE CITY

Take every bike for a test ride. Cruise through the city, open it up on the highway and weave through traffic. Rev your engine to turn heads, meet NPCs on the street and invite special passengers along for a spin. Build relationships and earn your name in the biker community.

FROM SMALL GARAGE TO BIG DEALERSHIP

Reinvest your profits to expand your workshop and showroom so you can handle more bikes at once. Buy your own house to rest, skip time and manage your growing business. And keep an eye on the fuel gauge: running out of gas halfway through a test ride is not a great sales pitch.

A CITY THAT FEELS ALIVE

Traffic, pedestrians and a dynamic day-night cycle make every ride feel different. From negotiating with sellers to managing repairs and tracking your finances, every decision shapes your business.
